## Mutation {#mutation}

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?&tab=api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>

```graphql {4-5,13-14,23-25} showLineNumbers
mutation RequestOnlineCards {
  requestMerchantPaymentMethods(
    input: {
      merchantProfileId: "$YOUR_MERCHANT_PROFILE_ID"
      onlineCard: { activate: true }
    }
  ) {
    ... on RequestMerchantPaymentMethodsSuccessPayload {
      __typename
      merchantProfile {
        merchantPaymentMethods {
          methodId
          ... on OnlineCardMerchantPaymentMethod {
            methodId
            paymentAmountLimit {
              currency
              value
            }
            rollingReserve {
              percentage
              rollingDays
            }
            type
            statusInfo {
              status
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    ... on ForbiddenRejection {
      __typename
      message
    }
    ... on ValidationRejection {
      __typename
      message
    }
    ... on InternalErrorRejection {
      __typename
      message
    }
    ... on NotFoundRejection {
      id
      message
    }
    ... on InvalidPaymentMethodRequestRejection {
      __typename
      message
      paymentMethods {
        code
        id
        message
        type
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Payload {#payload}

The payload confirms that the payment method `OnlineCard` was requested successfully with the status `Enabled`.

```json {8,17,19} showLineNumbers
{
  "data": {
    "requestMerchantPaymentMethods": {
      "__typename": "RequestMerchantPaymentMethodsSuccessPayload",
      "merchantProfile": {
        "merchantPaymentMethods": [
          {
            "methodId": "$PAYMENT_METHOD_ID",
            "paymentAmountLimit": {
              "currency": "EUR",
              "value": "150"
          },
            "rollingReserve": {
              "percentage": "100",
              "rollingDays": "5"
          },
            "type": "OnlineCard",
            "statusInfo": {
              "status": "Enabled"
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```
